title: 森の京都四季編（ロゴあり）
description: 冬、大地が静かに眠る季節。澄んだ空気の中、息づく人々の営みと伝統。春、芽吹く命と彩りを感じる季節。喜び溢れ人々を動かす新しいエネルギー。夏、太陽と水が躍る季節。人々に生きる糧を与える山と川の恵み。秋、実りを分かち合う季節。色鮮やかな山々に包まれる人々の感謝と祈り。四季が巡り、自然と人々が調和する場所。森の京都。

title: Forest of Kyoto: Four Seasons Edition (with logo)
description: In winter, the earth quietly sleeps. In the clear air, the activities and traditions of the people come to life. In spring, one feels the budding life and colors. A new energy that overflows with joy moves the people. In summer, the sun and water dance. The mountains and rivers provide the sustenance for the people. In autumn, the season of sharing the harvest. The people are enveloped in the colorful mountains, expressing gratitude and prayer. The four seasons cycle, a place where nature and people harmonize. The Forest of Kyoto.
